title: Lecture 4 — functions, Git, and the Unix shell
summary: Separate function inputs and results, navigate a project, and inspect a staged change.
body:
The published topic is **Functions, Git, and the Unix Shell**. Slides were not linked when checked on 2 November. These independent guides cover the listed topics; they are not a transcript of the classroom demonstration.

Check the [lecture page](https://canvas.kth.se/courses/65461/pages/lectures) for new slides. Practice commands in a disposable folder.
